overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed outcome.detail would be unique across all outcomes in all case studies, but multiple studies can have the same placeholder text like '[Outcome — what changed.]'
why_it_breaks: When multiple case studies contain outcomes with identical placeholder detail text (e.g. '[Outcome — what changed.]'), React sees duplicate keys across the entire list of rendered outcomes, causing the 6 warnings (2 outcomes per study × 3 studies = 6 duplicates)
